text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower was going to participate in a joint dance lesson, so I accompanied her—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Hahaha! Allow me to show you! Behold my exemplary Bakushin steps!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Softly, like a gentle breeze caressing the cheek—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah--

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"You're both amazing...
You look so vibrant, I just can't take my eyes off you...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
How in the world
does she dance like that...?
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because it expresses your "true self"?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Authenticity"—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“I see...
Because they're dancing true to themselves, that's why they're so...—”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Then I... want to dance in my own way too."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Still, what kind of expression would truly be "like me," I wonder?
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, why don't we ask?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Is that... for the two of them?

I nod in agreement.
In searching for an expression unique to Nishino Flower,
the first person I'd like to consult is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"What makes Flower-san who she is!
That would be, without a doubt! Giving it her absolute all!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-san is an exemplary person whose serious, earnest, and Bakushin-worthy efforts match my very own!
You simply need to express that through your dance!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, just like this!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eh, wha...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—Now, Miss Flower!
Won't you join me in performing some exemplary, bakushin steps?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes!
I'll give it everything I've got!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Splendid as always, Flower-san!
Now then, let us pick up the pace even further!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh!? M-My speed!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's BAKUSHIIIIIN!!
Nishino Flower desperately tries to keep up with the speed of Sakura Bakushin O's steps. Though bewildered at first—
In Nishino Flower's earnest dancing, there was certainly a clue to grasping what made her truly unique...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: “—In that case, it might be faster to just see it for yourself.”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Have you look at it...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Shall we get going, then?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh!? P-Please wait up!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I think that's just Flower being herself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Flowers?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Blooming even while swayed by the wind...
Such bravery, such lovely grace...
Or perhaps, pure strength...—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it the very same thing
that dwells within you?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Z-Zephyr-san?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: See, Flower? Feel this breeze—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
F-Feel the wind...
Like this?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're doing great.
More naturally, more freely,
just surrender yourself to what flows through your body—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes.
More naturally... freely...!"

As she danced alongside Yamanin Zephyr,
the tension gradually left Nishino Flower's body,
and her steps became smooth and natural.

Within those subtle shifts in movement,
there truly lay the hint needed
to capture her true essence...!
